channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: L-G Manoj Sinha Reaffirms Zero-Tolerance Terror Policy, Distributes Jobs to Terror Victims' Families
item.description: The Lieutenant Governor handed over appointment letters to 39 Next of Kins (NoKs) of terror victims from the Kashmir Division at Lok Bhawan. Reiterating the government's commitment, Sinha said the administration is determined to deliver justice, employment and dignity to families devastated by terrorism.

item.title: 'I've been to jail before': D.K. Shivakumar says he is not afraid of PM Modi or Amit Shah amid flat owners' row
item.description: The furious response of the Deputy Chief Minister came after a warning from a flat owner that apartment owners form a large group and, if neglected, could influence voters in the upcoming Bengaluru civic polls.

item.title: Kolkata Police Arrest Messi GOAT Tour Organiser Satadru Dutta After Chaos at Salt Lake Stadium
item.description: Kolkata Police arrested GOAT Tour organiser Satadru Dutta after chaos erupted at Lionel Messi's event at Salt Lake Stadium. Dutta was detained while travelling to Hyderabad and has given a written assurance to refund all ticket buyers. Police officials said an investigation is underway, a government committee will probe the mismanagement, and authorities have ensured that fans will be compensated.

item.title: No July 13, No Dec 5: UT Administration Defies Political Push, Keeps 2026 Holiday List Unchanged
item.description: Despite pressure from the ruling National Conference and other parties, the UT administration retains the post-2019 holiday list; Omar Abdullah says authority rests with the Centre.

item.title: November market performance: Nifty 50, Nifty Midcap 150 top the charts
item.description: The broader market also delivered healthy gains, with the Nifty 500 gaining 0.94 per cent in the previous month, with large and midcap stocks up about 1-2 per cent and smallcaps corrected by around 1-3 per cent.

item.title: Messi plays football with Telangana CM, greets fans; internet claims Rs 10 lakh photo fee; did SRK pay to click with Messi?
item.description: Argentine football icon Lionel Messi visited the Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium and played football with Telangana CM Revanth Reddy. He also interacted with Rahul Gandhi. He will next visit Mumbai on Sunday, where it has been reported that Virat Kohli, Anushka Sharma, and Kareena Kapoor will be meeting him.

item.title: Gold, Silver Prices Surge: 24K Gold Up Rs 4,188, Silver Nears Rs 2 Lakh/kg
item.description: According to data from the India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA), the price of 24-karat gold increased by Rs 4,188 to Rs 1,32,710 per 10 grams, compared to Rs 1,28,592 a week ago. The price of 22-karat gold climbed to Rs 1,21,562 per 10 grams from Rs 1,17,777, while 18-karat gold rose to Rs 99,533 per 10 grams from Rs 96,444.

item.title: US counterterrorism nominee says ISIS and al-Qaida remain active, threatening global security
item.description: "ISIS and al-Qaida continue to recruit, radicalise and encourage their followers across the globe to conduct attacks in their home countries," LoGerfo said during his conformation hearing.

item.title: Shameful for Bengal, Mamata should take responsibility': BJP on Messi event chaos
item.description: The incident happened on Sunday when agitated spectators, angered over limited access to Messi despite purchasing tickets at what they described as exorbitant prices, went on a rampage inside the stadium.

item.title: Delhi chokes under hazardous smog as air quality worsens; visibility low
item.description: According to data released by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), Delhi's average Air Quality Index (AQI) climbed to 461 at 7 a.m. on Sunday, up from 431 recorded a day earlier. The alarming figures underscored the deepening air quality crisis gripping the national capital.
